hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "SECURITY CHECK: Before committing, verify the diff contains NO infrastructure details: no server hostnames, no IP addresses, no usernames, no private domain names. These must NEVER appear in public files (CHANGELOG, README, INSTALL, etc.). The git pre-commit hook will also block the commit if patterns from ~/.tradinebotte-test.conf are found in the staged diff."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "REMINDER: This project maintains 10 bilingual files that must always be updated together in the same commit: README.md + README.fr.md, CHANGELOG.md + CHANGELOG.fr.md, INSTALL.md + INSTALL.fr.md, QUICKSTART.md + QUICKSTART.fr.md, UPDATE.md + UPDATE.fr.md. Never modify one without updating its counterpart."}}'
